name: Adobe Creative Cloud Student Discount
description: Creative Cloud Pro for $19.99/month (first year) for students and teachers
fullDescription: Adobe offers students and teachers Creative Cloud Pro, with 20+ apps including Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and Acrobat, for $19.99/month for the first year (regularly $69.99/month).
whatTheyOffer:
- Creative Cloud Pro for $19.99/month for the first year (71% off $69.99)
- Then $39.99/month after the first year
- 20+ creative apps including Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and Acrobat
- 100GB cloud storage
- Annual plan, billed monthly
howToGetIt:
1. Visit adobe.com/creativecloud/buy/students.html
2. Select the Students & Teachers plan
3. Adobe may ask for a school-issued email or documents (student ID, class schedule, transcript, teacher ID, pay slip, or offer letter)
4. Students ages 13+ enrolled at accredited schools (K-12, college, university, qualified online programs) are eligible
5. Teachers and staff employed at accredited schools are eligible
keywords: Adobe, Creative Cloud Pro, student discount, teacher discount, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, Acrobat, 71% off
